tool_args.rationale: The six observations include a discriminating low-gradient branch point and vary in u_now and s_grad, while all gradients remain below the noted avalanche regime. Fit the numerically parameterized subcritical siphon law; the implementation keeps fitted parameters in module state so predict(row) uses the completed fit rather than an undefined train_rows variable.

considered_alternatives.option: Acquire another probe, especially a high-sgrad regime probe
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: No measured gradient exceeds the cited avalanche threshold, and the observed rows vary in both u_now and s_grad sufficiently to fit the three-parameter subcritical form; additional probing is not presently needed.
It depends only on u_now and cannot explain the substantial response differences across rows with similar u_now but differing s_grad.
It predicts monotonic power dependence on s_grad, whereas the observations indicate a gradient-associated sink/suppression effect.
